en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground stands a prominent historic building with a tall tower and steep roof, likely a town hall or civic building, surrounded by trees and streets with residential houses. Farmland and wooded hills stretch into the background. At the bottom left, white printed text reads "Eibenstock i. Erzgeb." indicating the location.
